title: The Torah - The Five Books of Moses
author: Jewish Publication Society
description: The Torah brings together Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers and Deuteronomy in the Jewish Publication Society's translation. Its narratives, laws and covenant traditions form the foundation of Jewish scriptural life.
